author: Engineezy
description:
This was supposed to draw a star
•••
But I accidentally discovered that just by changing the ratio between the stationary pulley and the pulley that spins the second linkage, you can drastically change the output path of the mechanism.  The start is created with a 2.5:1 ratio, while the triangle is created by a 4:1 ratio, and the oval comes from a 2:1 ratio.  The belt tensioner system was designed to use the same belt size for all 3 pulleys.
•••

title: Star Drawing Mechanism with a surprise
